profile.dividendPolicy: The Company has a policy to pay dividends at a rate of not less than 50 percent of the net profit after deducting all reserves. The dividend payment must not affect the operation, financial position, liquidity, business expansion, necessity and other suitability in the future, and other factors involved in the management of the Company as the Board of Directors deems suitable or appropriate. In this regard, such action must be undertaken in a manner that maximizes the benefits for the shareholders.
